desc: Derive the invariant: operation swaps same-parity gaps two apart, so each parity class can be arbitrarily permuted.
Determine optimal assignment: sort each parity class in nondecreasing order and weight by decreasing coefficients N-1-j.

Implement the Python solution: read N and X, compute gaps g[j]=X[j+1]-X[j], split into even and odd 0-based index lists, sort each list, then compute ans = N*X[0] + sum over gap positions j of (N-1-j)*assigned_gap (even gaps from sorted even list, odd gaps from sorted odd list) and print ans as an integer.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=4, already sorted parity gaps, and maximum-size/large-value inputs.
